announcement.SChinese:
模组市场
• 新增 BepInEx 模组市场：浏览、搜索、排序、下拉刷新
• 支持按分类筛选，顶部改为全部 / 精选 / 作者 + 线上标签
• 列表与详情显示标签、分类，以及适配的游戏版本（与当前游戏不一致时标红）
• 非中文界面默认显示英文模组名，搜索仍同时匹配中英文
• 市场列表增加回到顶部按钮

整合包
• 整合包详情「+」菜单：手动导入、自动扫描下载目录中的 .dll、从其他整合包导入
• 从其他整合包导入时会一并复制对应配置、附属文件、显示名称和开关状态，并支持全选 / 取消全选
• 模组可设置分类，并按分类筛选查看
• 整合包可填写适配游戏版本；导入不匹配时会弹出确认，列表也会显示适配版本
• 模组列表增加回到顶部按钮
• modpack.json 改为统一的 mods 结构（旧字段仍可自动迁移）

游戏内
• 新增插件声明式 UI 通道，模组可弹出独立悬浮窗口
• 优化游戏内菜单主题、控件间距与标签页动画

修复
• 从整合包返回主页时底部白边 / 导航栏闪烁
• 市场分类横向滑动时误切底部页面
• 多处本地化与界面细节
announcement.English:
Mod Market
• Added a BepInEx marketplace with browse, search, sort, and pull-to-refresh
• Filter by category; the top chips are now All / Featured / Authors plus online tags
• Cards and details show tags, category, and compatible game versions (highlighted in red when they do not match the installed game)
• Non-Chinese UI languages prefer the English mod name; search still matches both names
• Added a back-to-top button on the market list

Modpacks
• The pack detail + menu now supports manual import, auto-scan of .dll files in Downloads, and import from another pack
• Importing from another pack copies matching configs, sidecar files, display names, and enable state, with select-all / deselect-all
• Mods can be assigned categories and filtered by category
• Packs can declare a compatible game version; mismatched imports prompt before continuing, and the list shows the target version
• Added a back-to-top button on the mod list
• modpack.json now stores per-mod extras in a unified mods map (legacy fields are still imported)

In-game
• Added a declarative UI bridge so plugins can open their own overlay windows
• Polished the in-game menu theme, control spacing, and tab animations

Fixes
• White strip / flashing bottom navigation when returning from a pack to Home
• Horizontal category swipes no longer change the main pager tab
• Various localization and UI polish updates
